current.text: He is on a two-way contract with Memphis.
He sits behind Ty Jerome, Scotty Pippen Jr. and Cam Spencer in the Memphis guard rotation. Ty Jerome has started both preseason games.
Memphis has a crowded guard group and is expected to use a deep rotation of 11 or 12 players.
The experts expect him not to play most nights, so he is not relevant for fantasy this season.
He ranked 100th in fantasy after last season's trade deadline.
With so few projected minutes, points, rebounds and steals project as clear weaknesses, and he does not help in any counting category.

durable.text: He is a real NBA player who looks like a rotation-level point guard.
